researchTrial.method: Validate hash-bound construction inputs, manufacture an editable 3D prototype, and directly review its rendered appearance before completion.
researchTrial.review: The concept shows jacket, overskirt, and shorts appearance; it does not establish sewing order, dimensions, allowance, fabric stretch, avatar fitting, or deformation.

releaseBoundary: Prototype geometry only. Rendered visualAppearanceReview, fit, runtime, and customer release evidence remain unverified and mandatory before release.

clothSimulation.evidence: V18 reruns the bounded neutral cloth trial on the newly revised sewn panels; fit, shape-key response, motion, and material calibration remain unverified.
clothSimulation.reason: The shorts now use a provisional segmented thigh and crotch-rise outline; bending evidence is remeasured for the current pattern, target and assembly pose. Fit, gusset, Shape Key and motion acceptance remain open.

jacket-sleeves.reason: Direct review shows excessive sleeve wrinkling in the neutral render. Compare a structured sleeve cloth setting with the existing 0.45 baseline; 2.2 is a local prototype trial value, not a Lilac fabric calibration.
jacket-sleeves.evidenceBoundary: One neutral 48-frame trial against the current jacket sleeve panels; this parameter experiment does not establish fit, motion, material behavior, appearance approval, or release readiness.

pleated-overskirt.reason: V13 at stiffness 20 retained a broad fan and V14 at stiffness 4 collapsed into coarse uneven facets. Compare a middle stiffness value on the panel-local fold geometry; this is a local prototype hypothesis, not fabric calibration, fit, or appearance approval.
pleated-overskirt.evidenceBoundary: V25 changes only the authored pleat displacement field and its valley profile while preserving the V24 sewn panels and weights. The single regenerated mesh and cloth result require direct pose and appearance inspection; they do not establish fit, motion, fabric calibration, or release acceptance.

jacket-sleeves.reason: Direct neutral and pose renders still show physical sleeve corrugation after the bounded cloth solve. Compare a low-strength interior-only fairing pass while locking all open garment boundaries and sewn pins.
jacket-sleeves.evidenceBoundary: Three post-bake uniform Laplacian iterations at factor 0.18 on non-boundary sleeve vertices only. Exact source, displacement statistics, fixed-boundary count, and resulting mesh hashes are recorded by this run. This is a geometry hypothesis only; it does not establish fit, fold quality, motion, appearance approval, or release readiness.

frontClosure.construction: Right-front hem crosses center by 40 mm in local pattern coordinates, tapering to zero at the upper opening; left front supplies continuous underlay to center. Existing shoulder and side seams retain their common vertices.
frontClosure.evidenceBoundary: Corrects a cut-away lower front into an actual overlap hypothesis. 40 mm extension and 2 mm spacing are design hypotheses, not avatar-approved ease. Closure anchoring, dynamic overlap separation, trim and final fit remain unverified.

prototypeWeightRegions.evidenceBoundary: V21 preserves existing prototype weights and extends their ownership to the new center lap panels. This does not claim pose coverage, fit, collision, opacity, or release acceptance.

weightProfile.evidenceBoundary: V24 trial changes only forwardHemThighWeight from 0.18 to 0.72 to test whether stronger anterior lap-to-thigh following prevents the extended apron from lagging behind raised thighs. Waist anchoring, centerline balance, geometry, and the 0.75 cap remain unchanged. This is an unverified deformation hypothesis requiring new rendered coverage, seam inspection, collision review, and direct appearance review; it grants no fit or release acceptance.
